theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (fun x => Φ ↑x) s := by
  have hΦ : ∀ (n : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → ‖Φ ↑n‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro n
    intro hnz
    rw [ZMod.val_injective]
    exact Complex.norm_one
  apply LSeriesSummable_of_bounded_of_one_lt_re
  exact ⟨hΦ, hs⟩
